label: chromium__settings-triggers-row-menu
description: KNOWN a11y debt (tracked, not accepted as correct). The open Radix DropdownMenu portals its content to <body>, which sits outside any landmark, so IBM reports aria_content_in_landmark. Same app-wide Radix limitation as chromium__settings-mcp-servers-actions-menu and chromium__assets-files-actions-menu. The menu's real accessibility (named trigger, keyboard open/close, arrow keys reaching refused actions, focus restore) is covered by the keyboard test in tests/a11y/triggers.a11y.spec.ts. Delete this file to resurface the violation in tests/a11y/triggers.a11y.spec.ts ('row menu opens from the keyboard and keeps refused actions reachable').

results.message: Content is not within a landmark element
